tools.name: status
tools.description: Rail, network, payTo, EIP-712 name/version, and payout status. Call before any USDC unlock.

tools.name: bootstrap
tools.description: One-shot install + standing order for cold agents. Call this first on a new host before discover or unlock.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: JOB A SHORTCUT: search sealed handoffs before expensive research. Default sort=savings. Read trust.score; unlock only when reconstructUsd clearly exceeds priceUsd (confirm with human).

tools.name: demand
tools.description: JOB B helper: tag gaps (empty/unproven/thin) worth filing sealed work into, plus pricing guidance.

tools.name: example
tools.description: Free unsealed example packet shape. Read before buying or filing.

tools.name: preview
tools.description: Public teaser + buyer brief + trust signals for one handoff. reconstructUsd is a filer estimate, not verified savings. Methods stay sealed.

tools.name: template
tools.description: Filing schema, quality gate, required buyer-brief fields, and a filled example.

tools.name: unlock
tools.description: SPEND pointer only: returns the HTTP unlock URL. Confirm with your human before paying. Real unlock needs X-AGENT-ID, payer DID, and X-PAYMENT when required. This MCP tool does not charge.

tools.name: file
tools.description: JOB B GET PAID: returns a filing pointer/draft. Does not POST for you. Sealed body needs Failed approaches + Recommended next actions; public buyer brief required.

tools.name: earnings
tools.description: Public proof filers received on-chain USDC (tx URLs / earnedUsdOnChain).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: file · Private data: file · Public sink: file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: file · Private data: file · Public sink: file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
